# Lens flare

Ghost reflections and a halo mirrored through the frame center from every bright spot, with color fringes, a starburst and lens dirt, as light bounces inside a camera lens.

<EffectDemo effect="lens-flare" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { lensFlare } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-flare';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(lensFlare({ preset: 'cinematic' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type    | Default | Range     | Description                                                |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity`  | number  | `1`     | 0 – 4     | Brightness of the flare.                                   |
| `threshold`  | number  | `1.5`   | 0 – 8     | Linear brightness above which light flares.                |
| `ghosts`     | integer | `5`     | 1 – 8     | Number of ghost reflections.                               |
| `spacing`    | number  | `0.35`  | 0.05 – 1  | Distance between ghosts along the line through the center. |
| `halo`       | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 2     | Brightness of the ring around the center.                  |
| `haloWidth`  | number  | `0.45`  | 0.1 – 0.8 | Radius of the ring.                                        |
| `chromatic`  | number  | `0.006` | 0 – 0.03  | Color fringing of the ghosts.                              |
| `starburst`  | number  | `0.4`   | 0 – 1     | Rays radiating from the center over the flare.             |
| `dirtAmount` | number  | `0.3`   | 0 – 1     | Smudges and specks on the lens that light up in the flare. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                      |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cinematic` | `intensity: 1.2`, `ghosts: 6`, `halo: 0.8`, `starburst: 0.6`  |
| `subtle`    | `intensity: 0.5`, `ghosts: 3`, `halo: 0.3`, `dirtAmount: 0.1` |
| `dirty`     | `dirtAmount: 0.9`, `intensity: 1.4`                           |
| `rainbow`   | `chromatic: 0.02`, `ghosts: 8`, `spacing: 0.25`               |

Apply one with `lensFlare({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 8.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-flare`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: John Chapman, Pseudo Lens Flare (2013): ghosts mirrored through the center, halo and chromatic distortion.
